rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=2, train_n=400, n_iter=30, val_n=200, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, lr=0.003, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=1, img_sr=0.0002, outer_wall_s=900, seed=42, rationale=iter-13 dual_domain_bilateral_n2i, ONE-KNOB: lr 0.002->0.003 (bracket the lr peak on the HIGH side), on iter-11 CHAMPION base (img_sr=0.0002, n_iter=30). lr AXIS now bracketed: 5e-3->hr0.126, 2e-3->hr0.1835 (PEAK so far), 1e-3->hr0.0895 (iter-12: UNDER-converged, SSIM crashed to 0.930 -- 30 steps from warm-start too few at this low lr). So the optimum is a PEAK near 2e-3 with steep falloff BELOW it (under-convergence) and gentler falloff ABOVE it (overshoot-to-noise). HYPOTHESIS: 3e-3 sits between the 2e-3 peak and the 5e-3 mild-overshoot; if hr(3e-3) < 0.1835 the peak is at/below 2e-3 and I stop refining lr (2e-3 confirmed optimal); if hr(3e-3) ~ or > 0.1835 the ridge is broad on the high side and 2-3e-3 is a plateau. Either way this NAILS the lr optimum in one clean step (val_n=200). BUDGET: same steps, ~950s. ONE knob: lr 0.002->0.003.
